tools.name: search_products
tools.rich: Products matching a search phrase, with name, price and product number. Not for the details of one known product and not for stock in a store.

params.name: query
params.rich: What to look for, as a product type or a feature.

params.name: max_price
params.rich: Highest price to show, in euros. No limit by default.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.rich: Description, specifications, price and ratings for one product, by product number. Not for stock in a store and not for finding products by a phrase.

params.name: product_id
params.rich: Product number: P- then five digits.

tools.name: check_store_stock
tools.rich: Units of one product on the shelves of one physical store today. Not for delivery times and not for stock available to order online.

params.name: product_id
params.rich: Product number: P- then five digits.

params.name: store_location
params.rich: The place where the store is.

tools.name: place_order
tools.rich: Buy a quantity of one product, delivered to the address saved on the account. Not for changing an order that was already placed.

params.name: product_id
params.rich: Product number: P- then five digits.

params.name: quantity
params.rich: How many to buy, 1 to 10.

params.name: delivery_option
params.rich: Delivery speed, or collection from a store: standard, express or collect_in_store.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.rich: Where one order is in its life: being prepared, shipped, delivered or cancelled. Not for what the order contains and not for the courier's scans of a parcel.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

tools.name: get_order_details
tools.rich: What one order contains: the items, quantities, totals and the delivery address. Not for its current status and not for shipping progress.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.rich: Stop one order that has not shipped yet and record why. Not for sending back an item that has already arrived.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

params.name: reason
params.rich: Why it is being stopped: ordered_by_mistake, found_cheaper, delivery_too_slow, no_longer_needed or other.

tools.name: update_delivery_address
tools.rich: Replace the delivery address of an order that has not shipped yet. Not for changing the delivery date.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

params.name: new_address
params.rich: The full new address on one line.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.rich: The courier's scans for one parcel: last scan, where it is and the expected delivery day. Not for the state of the order itself.

params.name: tracking_number
params.rich: Courier tracking number: TRK then eight digits.

tools.name: start_return
tools.rich: Begin sending back one item from a delivered order and get a prepaid label. Not for asking for the money back, and not for an order that has not arrived.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

params.name: item
params.rich: Which item, by its name.

params.name: reason
params.rich: Why it is going back: the wrong item arrived, it is not as described, it is no longer needed, or it does not work.

tools.name: request_refund
tools.rich: Ask for the money back for one item in an order. Not for sending the item back and not for stopping an order that has not shipped.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

params.name: item
params.rich: Which item, by its name.

params.name: refund_to
params.rich: Where the money goes: original_payment or store_credit. Defaults to original_payment.

tools.name: list_customer_orders
tools.rich: A customer's recent orders, newest first, with reference, date and total. Not for what is inside one order.

params.name: customer_id
params.rich: Customer number: C- then five digits.

params.name: status
params.rich: Only orders in this state: open, shipped, delivered or cancelled. All by default.

tools.name: apply_discount_code
tools.rich: Apply a promotional code to one order that has not shipped yet and report the new total. Not for finding out which codes exist.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

params.name: code
params.rich: The promotional code, 4 to 12 capital letters or digits.

tools.name: get_delivery_time
tools.rich: How many days delivery of one product to one place takes, with the arrival date, for one delivery speed. Not for following a parcel that was already sent.

params.name: product_id
params.rich: Product number: P- then five digits.

params.name: destination
params.rich: The place the product is going to.

params.name: delivery_option
params.rich: Delivery speed: standard or express.

tools.name: get_return_policy
tools.rich: The return window in days and who pays the return postage, for one product category. Not for starting a return.

params.name: category
params.rich: Product category: books, clothing, electronics, home_and_garden, toys or food_and_drink.

tools.name: reschedule_delivery
tools.rich: Move the delivery of an order that has not shipped to another date and time slot. Not for changing the delivery address.

params.name: order_reference
params.rich: The order reference from the confirmation email.

params.name: delivery_date
params.rich: New delivery date, YYYY-MM-DD.
